# BADAT Games

> BADAT Games is a game development company website featuring information about its games, team, company, news, and related legal policies.

## Website

- https://www.badatgames.net/ — BADAT Games home page and company overview
- https://www.badatgames.net/game — All games developed or published by BADAT Games
- https://www.badatgames.net/team — BADAT Games team members
- https://www.badatgames.net/news — Latest BADAT Games news and updates

## Games

- https://www.badatgames.net/game — Browse all BADAT Games
- https://www.badatgames.net/aboutgame/:name — Detailed information about an individual game

## News

- https://www.badatgames.net/news — Browse BADAT Games news and announcements
- https://www.badatgames.net/aboutnews/:id — Detailed information about a specific news article

## Company

- https://www.badatgames.net/ — BADAT Games company information
- https://www.badatgames.net/team — Information about the BADAT Games team

## Legal

- https://www.badatgames.net/tc — Terms and Conditions
- https://www.badatgames.net/pp — Privacy Policy

## Notes

BADAT Games provides information about its games, company, team, and news through the website.

Dynamic routes use the following patterns:

- `/aboutgame/:name` — Individual game pages
- `/aboutnews/:id` — Individual news pages
